text:
Inline slider–crank
x(θ) = r cosθ + √(l² − r² sin²θ)
Crank radius r
Connecting-rod length l > r
Stroke = 2r
provenance: Factual relations and notation. Source: Robert L. Williams II, Ohio University, ME 3011 Kinematics and Dynamics of Machines notes; https://people.ohio.edu/williams/html/PDF/NotesBook3011.pdf. Consulted 2026-10-13.

text:
Inline slider–crank, l > r
θ = 0 → x = l + r
θ = π → x = l − r
dx/dθ = 0 at both dead centers
Axial piston force → zero crank torque at dead center
provenance: Factual relations and notation. Source: Robert L. Williams II, Ohio University, ME 3011 Kinematics and Dynamics of Machines notes; https://people.ohio.edu/williams/html/PDF/NotesBook3011.pdf. Consulted 2026-10-13.
